concerns: ProxyValidationService uses a synchronous Socket connection check in the HTTP request handling thread without a dedicated thread pool or asynchronous mechanism, which could lead to thread starvation if many invalid proxies are tested concurrently.
The controller catches generic Exceptions and returns the raw e.getMessage() in the HTTP response body, which can leak internal stack trace details or database schema names to end users.
When onboarding an account with the same phone number multiple times, the old session data is overwritten completely without backing it up or warning the user.

verdicts.criticalReason: The PR commits multiple internal orchestrator bookkeeping files under the `.eneik/` directory (such as `.eneik/records/review-verdict-20260724-013057072.json`, `.eneik/records/review-verdict-20260724-014429260.json`, `.eneik/records/review-verdict-20260724-020729989.json`, and `.eneik/review-verdict.json`), which is a direct violation of the PR Boundaries and causes automatic rejection.

concerns: The save action currently only prints settings to console.log and does not persist them via any API endpoint or local storage.
When adding a custom rule, the name 'New Custom Rule' and description are hardcoded, and the UI lacks input fields for editing the new rule's name or description inline.
